periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped blobs with a vertical-diagonal length greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering below the geometric center, creating a teardrop morphology.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide band occupying approximately one-third of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide white inter-pinna gap roughly equal to the lateral width of one ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.
